report_title: LAMBOSPEC AI — Global Lamborghini Buyer Intelligence & Market Defect Pool
active_sources: Bring a Trailer Verified Transaction Comps & Bid History
NHTSA Official Safety Recalls & Technical Service Bulletins (TSBs)
RM Sotheby's, Gooding & Co, Mobile.de European Supercar Listings
Independent Specialist Marque Diagnostics (Leonardo / LARA / ODIS)

what_buyers_want: Verified Front Axle Lift system (essential for urban drivability and resale preservation)
Proven clutch life readouts via factory diagnostics (LDF, ISR, and E-Gear percentages)
Verified Carbon Ceramic Rotor (CCB) health by physical micrometer thickness & disc weight (grams)
Zero unreported Thrust Mode / Launch Control track abuses in ECU telemetry
Transparent engine bonnet with LED lighting package (major resale differentiator on V10/V12)
Factory sport exhaust or documented warranty-friendly valved systems
Ad Personam interior stitching, contrast accents, and carbon package documentation
Continuous, uninterrupted annual service binder from authorized dealers or elite marque specialists
primary_buyer_fears_and_pain_points: Buying a car with worn CCB rotors that look visually okay but are oxidized (facing an immediate $24,000 - $28,000 replacement)
Aventador ISR clutch rod seal failure resulting in unexpected $14,000 - $18,000 gearbox teardown
Missing Front Axle Lift resulting in instant $10,000 - $12,000 resale valuation penalty
MagneRide active suspension shock absorber fluid weeping requiring $8,000 - $35,000 replacements
Urus high-pressure fuel pump torque defect or turbo oil feed O-ring engine-valley flooding
Unreported track duty: hidden frame micro-flexing, Cofango carbon weave stress cracks, and over-rev codes
Parasitic battery drain causing cascade of ghost check engine lights and instrument cluster glitches

chronic_checkpoints.failure_mechanism: Microscopic carbon matrix oxidation from track heat. Visual pad check is useless; rotors must be removed and weighed against stamped minimum weight (grams).
Magnetic fluid weeping from seal heads causes harsh damping, loss of high-speed stability, and suspension fault codes.
Pump microswitch failure or pressure line seal weep. Missing lift carries brutal market stigma.
Oil weeping on undertray; differential casing damp around driveshaft flange.
Excessive launches (>15) accelerate front differential clutch pack wear and half-shaft spline play.
Single-clutch automated manual suffers rapid clutch wear in stop-and-go driving. Release bearing binding and hydraulic actuator O-ring failure.
Horizontal Öhlins magnetorheological dampers leak hydraulic fluid. Factory replacement quotes reach staggering numbers.
Overfilling fuel tank combined with revving with aftermarket exhaust leads to fuel vapors entering exhaust and catching fire.
Heavy thermal load causes plastic coolant tank micro-fractures and radiator core corrosion in hot climates.

chronic_checkpoints.component: High-Pressure Fuel Pump Torque (SE Hybrid Safety Recall)
chronic_checkpoints.failure_mechanism: Insufficient bolt torque on high-pressure pump to cylinder head causing fuel leaks and severe fire risk.

chronic_checkpoints.component: Turbo Oil Supply Line O-Rings & Oil Separator
chronic_checkpoints.failure_mechanism: O-rings degrade under high turbo heat, pooling oil in the hot V valley. Excessive cylinder deactivation blow-by.
Software logic bug prevents backup camera display when shifting quickly to reverse upon startup.

revuelto_temerario_hybrids.platform: V12 HPEV & 10,000 RPM Twin-Turbo V8 Hybrid

chronic_checkpoints.component: Upward Door Spherical Pin Support (Revuelto Recall)
chronic_checkpoints.failure_mechanism: Spherical mounting pin for dihedral door gas spring detaches, causing door to drop suddenly or fail to open.
Requires official dealer verification of 8-year high-voltage battery cell balance and software firmware patch.
Requires LARA/Leonardo diagnostic scan to read clutch thickness percentage. < 30% means imminent replacement.
Extreme exhaust pipe heat radiating close to rear polyurethane bumper causes blistering and taillight socket melting.
Aged rear main seal drips oil directly onto clutch plate, causing severe slippage and catastrophic clutch contamination.

chronic_checkpoints.component: Engine Bay Wiring Loom Heat Shielding
chronic_checkpoints.failure_mechanism: Aftermarket straight pipes or decat exhausts scorch the factory wiring harness above the catalytic converters.

verified_dealer_counter_scripts.scenario: Dealer claims carbon ceramic brakes are 'in great shape' based on visual inspection
verified_dealer_counter_scripts.buyer_script: Lamborghini workshop manual specifically states CCB disc condition cannot be certified visually due to interior carbon fiber matrix oxidation. Please provide the stamped minimum weight (g) and current micrometer scale weight for all four corners. If measurements cannot be provided, we must deduct $24,000 for impending rotor replacement.

verified_dealer_counter_scripts.scenario: Dealer claims lack of Front Axle Lifting System is 'not a big deal'
verified_dealer_counter_scripts.buyer_script: Historical Bring a Trailer and auction comp data over the past 18 months verifies an immediate 5.2% to 6.8% ($10,000 - $12,000) liquidity and resale penalty on Huracáns and Aventadors without the factory lift. We require an immediate $11,000 price adjustment to proceed.

verified_dealer_counter_scripts.scenario: Dealer claims Aventador ISR gearbox shifts 'normally for a supercar'
verified_dealer_counter_scripts.buyer_script: We require an official ODIS diagnostic printout showing the clutch wear index, bite-point adaptation cycles, and accumulator hydraulic pressure test. If clutch wear exceeds 65%, a mandatory $14,000 reserve must be credited toward the bill of sale.
